title: 36 Hours in Curaçao
abstract: Your weekend agenda on this Dutch West Indies isle: cove-hopping, sipping blue Curaçao liqueur, exploring a complex past and late-night people-watching.

title: 36 Hours in Niseko
abstract: Sublime skiing, snowboarding and “snow-surfing” are only part of the story in this Japanese resort. Culinary adventures abound, local whiskey flows and hot springs are the perfect après-ski option.

title: 36 Hours in Basel
abstract: It might be known for Art Basel, but this riverside city in Switzerland is also the birthplace of Roger Federer, has some 40 museums and cherishes its many traditions.

title: 36 Hours in Queenstown, New Zealand
abstract: The adventure capital is a gateway to countless thrills, but after all the hiking and bungee jumping, the town offers a few adventures of its own.
